entries.claim: The UK government announced that the lower Soft Drinks Industry Levy sugar threshold will reduce from 5g to 4.5g per 100ml from January 2028.
entries.limitations: This is category regulation, not evidence of LOA formulation, demand or performance.

entries.validation_step: Confirm the final legislation and verify LOA recipes independently before making any formulation claim.

entries.claim: The UK government reported a 46% average reduction in sugar content in in-scope soft drinks between 2015 and 2020.

entries.validation_step: Use the latest official category data and obtain product-level evidence before commercial use.
